summary: XCOM entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: XCOM: Enemy Unknown
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC Complete Pack, with Enemy Within state explicitly recorded

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; console/mobile only for comparison.

primary.version: XCOM: Enemy Unknown Complete Pack / Enemy Within-enabled PC route
primary.why: The PC Complete Pack route gives the best tactical capture path and can include Enemy Within plus DLC. Enemy Within substantially alters the campaign, so the archive should record whether the base Enemy Unknown campaign or the expansion-enhanced campaign was played.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC Complete Pack. Record storefront, patch, DLC installed, whether Enemy Within is enabled, difficulty, Ironman state, Second Wave options, soldiers lost, council/base progress, and save-scum/mod state.

secondary.why: PC is better for capture and interface flexibility.
Touch route is distinct but not the archive fidelity target.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with the 1994 X-COM/UFO Defense entry or XCOM 2; record expansion and Ironman state.
